title: Fullstack-Developer (100% Remote)
description:
We're looking for Junior and Senior Developers to join our fully remote team. If you like complexity and want your work to actually matter, you'll fit right in.

About Us

is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. Our mission is to automate everything a property manager does.

What you'll do

You'll build with Claude and Cursor. What exactly you work on depends on where you land — our work splits roughly like this:

  • Product (Full-Stack). Work on the software property managers use all day. Help us improve what's there and push our roadmap forward by owning new features and refining them until they're as easy to use as the Uber app.

  • Integrations (Backend). Handle every way data gets into our platform. Email, phone calls (Twilio & Vonage), WhatsApp. The other half is moving customers off whatever they used before: Importing years of email, hundreds of thousands of documents, and every record on their buildings, apartments, contracts and contacts, plus syncing with systems a customer still runs alongside us.

  • Agents (Backend). Improve the agent platform behind with 200+ tools and a built-in knowledge base. Customers build and train their own agents in a sandbox or use agents we've already built for them. Both text and voice.

Our minimalistic tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Salary

  • $1000 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

  • Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.

Requirements

You are:

  • fluent in English.

  • a seasoned developer with more than a year of experience shipping production code

  • a builder first. You'd rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship.

  • comfortable working autonomously and take full ownership of your tasks.

  • writing almost al of your code with AI.

  • performing even better when working under performance pressure.

  • quick to learn new things and consider yourself a generalist, not a specialist.

Your techstack:

is not important to us, since AI will be writing 100% of your code.

Nice to have:

  • Solid backend and systems-design experience – experience designing a database from the ground up (tables, relationships, indexes) and also with optimizing query performance & cost

  • Experience building production agents

  • Comfort with queues and long-running workflows

title: Frontend Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

📍 Location:Remote - this role is available across all EU/LATAM countries with 4hr+ overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

As our Frontend Engineer, you’ll own and build major product surfaces end-to-end. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership.

Where you'll create impact

  • You’ll own end-to-end execution for core frontend features in React +

  • You’ll build and deliver intuitive, high-performance UI that makes complex workflows simple

  • You’ll collaborate with product, design, and backend engineering to ship fast and with clarity

  • You’ll strengthen our frontend architecture, performance, accessibility, and responsiveness

  • You’ll help shape our component library and frontend system as we scale

  • You’ll elevate the quality and polish of the product with user empathy and attention to detail

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 5+ years experience in frontend development with React ( a strong plus)

  • Proven track record in high-growth environments

  • Deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals and modern frontend principles

  • Strong grasp of responsive UI, accessibility, and usability

  • Comfort building and testing APIs; experience with HTTP, Postman, debugging

  • Clear product intuition, design sensitivity, and craftsmanship

  • Pragmatic mindset with high-speed execution

  • Curiosity, autonomy, and ownership

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $65K–$120K USD

  • Equity: ~$30K

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team — the fastest team you will have ever worked with\

  • 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.
